_meta.what: Daily ATM ~360D implied-vol snapshot taken at scan time. Percentile = rank vs this file's own history.
_meta.honesty: ESTIMATED until this file holds 60 trading days. Today is the seed snapshot, so every percentile below is estimated, not sourced. Wire Market Data App / Tradier (one API key) or ORATS for a sourced IV rank.
_meta.fields: atm_iv_pct = ATM implied vol; iv_percentile_est = rank vs own (short) history; skew = 90% put IV minus ATM IV (vol points)
_meta.source: US single names: ATM ~360D implied vol by Black-Scholes inversion on Yahoo option marks. EU names + gold (no listed options on Yahoo): realized vol from 1y of daily closes, used as an implied proxy, with a sourced percentile vs trailing-year history. Stdlib cookie+crumb, no key, no deps. US IV percentile estimated until 60 daily snapshots.
